result:
The change resolves `package_name` for `version_option` correctly when the importable top-level module name doesn't match the installed distribution name (e.g. `yaml` vs `PyYAML`), using `importlib.metadata.packages_distributions()` for the mapping, falling back to the old module-name behavior when the mapping is missing or ambiguous.

Summary of changes:
- `src/click/decorators.py`: `version_option` now maps the detected top-level module name to its distribution name via `importlib.metadata.packages_distributions()` when unambiguous.
- `CHANGES.md`: added changelog entry referencing issues #1884, #2331, #3125.
- `tests/test_command_decorators.py`: added tests covering the mapped case and the ambiguous-fallback case.

All 1590 tests pass (via `uv run pytest`, which builds the local package into a venv rather than using a stale globally-installed `click`).
